dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt system (JMA standard receipt software), compiled with GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL on Linux; uses MCPAREA/SPAAREA/LINKAREA linkage pattern typical of ORCA
evidence: PROCEDURE DIVISION USING MCPAREA SPAAREA LINKAREA SCRAREA

purpose.domain_detail: JMA ORCA Japanese medical receipt (shinryo-hoshu) system — outpatient rapid examination body-check calculation information (W35 screen, gairaijinsoku kensatai kensa joho)
purpose.summary: This program implements the W35 screen of the JMA ORCA medical receipt system, handling outpatient rapid examination/body-check calculation information setup. It initialises screen data, reads and edits system management master records (tbl_syskanri, code 1016) for examination table configuration, and manages screen navigation and data entry for the examination list.

notable_features: Heavy use of COPY statements (68 copybooks) for screen layouts (W01.INC–W99.INC) and shared areas
LINKAGE SECTION with MCPAREA/SPAAREA/LINKAREA/SCRAREA — ORCA MCP framework
MCP-STATUS/MCP-EVENT EVALUATE for event-driven screen handling
Japanese text in comments (EUC-JP encoded, rendered as latin-1 mojibake)
No EXEC SQL — uses proprietary MCP DB access (PERFORM 910-DBSELECT-SEC etc.)
OCCURS 110 tables for examination code lists
EXIT PROGRAM pattern (subprogram called by MCP framework)
verdict.notes: Source comments are in Japanese EUC-JP encoding, decoded as latin-1 producing mojibake. File is truncated at 16000 chars but structure is clear. The program is a subprogram/screen module within the ORCA MCP framework, not a standalone batch program; classified as online-cics by analogy since MCP is ORCA's equivalent event-driven transaction framework.
